findings.claim: The skill no longer writes docs structure itself: it creates pages with `kmctl new doc TYPE TITLE` from the new ticket new-doc-verb (folder, skeleton, index entry) and writes only the prose, as the manifesto's 'skills route; kmctl writes' requires.

depends_on now names claude-plugin, new-doc-verb and knowledge-check; new-doc-verb depends on scaffold-init, so docs/README.md and its index format are fixed before this skill is built, and the done test runs in a repo set up with `kmctl init`.
